cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/streams_remaining.txt <<'EOF'
REAL streams divergences still open (measured against php -n 8.5.6):

1. stream_wrapper_unregister is inoperative. php refuses EVERY operation on a bare path after
   unregistering "file" (fopen, file_get_contents, file_exists, is_file, filesize, unlink,
   opendir — all false); elephc keeps working. Even an explicit scheme is unaffected:
   unregistering "data" then reading data://… still succeeds. Cause: the literal routes resolve
   the scheme at COMPILE time and never consult the disabled-wrapper mask. ~30 helpers.

2. glob() declares no $flags parameter at all. Blocked on a prerequisite: the GLOB_* constants
   are declared with macOS values under a "POSIX-portable" comment; glibc uses different bits.
   Activating flags without making the table per-target turns a latent defect into an active one.

3. Uncaught fatals carry no stack trace. php prints "Stack trace:\n#0 FILE(LINE): fn(args)\n
   #1 {main}\n  thrown in FILE on line N". elephc prints the message line only. The location half
   is now correct; the trace needs a call stack with argument rendering.

NON-streams gaps found by the same sweep, recorded but out of scope:
   - a stream builtin called through a foreach variable ($fn = "feof"; $fn($h)) is a fatal:
     runtime_callable_supported allows exactly three names (abs, gettype, trim).
   - array_map("strtoupper", …) does not compile.
   - symlink("", "x") answers true where php answers false (pre-existing, macOS creates the
     dangling link php refuses).
   - realpath("") answers false where php answers the CWD.
   - get_meta_tags, parse_ini_file, md5_file, similar_text are undefined; str_replace refuses its
     4th &$count parameter (max_args caps it at 3 while the catalogue declares the parameter).
   - $this->context is NULL in a wrapper opened without an explicit context; php always assigns
     one (resource of type stream-context).
EOF
